reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), currencies AS (
  -- one row per currency
  SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM subscriptions
), events AS (
  -- one row per subscription event
  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local, s.currency
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
)
SELECT m.month_start, c.currency,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date < m.month_start THEN x.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS opening_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'new' THEN x.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'expansion' THEN x.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'reactivation' THEN x.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'contraction' THEN x.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_mrr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= m.month_start AND x.event_type = 'churn' THEN x.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr,
  SUM(x.mrr_delta_local) AS closing_mrr
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN currencies c
JOIN events x ON x.currency = c.currency AND x.event_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY m.month_start, c.currency

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'), m AS (SELECT CAST(t.d AS DATE) AS ms, CAST(t.d + INTERVAL '1 month' AS DATE) AS nx FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month') AS t(d)), cur AS (SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM subscriptions)
SELECT m.ms AS month_start, cur.currency, COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_date < m.ms), 0) AS opening_mrr,
  COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type = 'new' AND ev.event_date >= m.ms AND ev.event_date < m.nx), 0) AS new_mrr,
  COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type = 'expansion' AND ev.event_date >= m.ms AND ev.event_date < m.nx), 0) AS expansion_mrr,
  COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type = 'reactivation' AND ev.event_date >= m.ms AND ev.event_date < m.nx), 0) AS reactivation_mrr,
  COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type = 'contraction' AND ev.event_date >= m.ms AND ev.event_date < m.nx), 0) AS contraction_mrr,
  COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type = 'churn' AND ev.event_date >= m.ms AND ev.event_date < m.nx), 0) AS churn_mrr,
  COALESCE(SUM(ev.d) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_date < m.nx), 0) AS closing_mrr
FROM m CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.currency = cur.currency GROUP BY m.ms, cur.currency
